description: Create real HS256-signed JWTs in your browser and decode/verify existing tokens, all client-side.

faqs.a: Header and payload JSON are base64url-encoded and signed with HMAC-SHA256 using your secret via WebCrypto.
Yes — paste any token and it decodes the header/payload; with the secret it also checks the signature.
faqs.q: Can I decode a token without the secret?

faqs.a: No. Signing and verification happen locally with the WebCrypto API; tokens never leave your device.

howto: Edit the header and payload JSON.
Type your HS256 secret and click Sign JWT.
Or paste a token below to decode and verify it.
title: JWT Encoder / Decoder
